Practically the entire scientific and pedagogical activity of V. B. Aleskovskii and his student S. I. Kol'tsov was related to solid state chemistry. In the walls of this institute between 1950 and the late 1960s they created and experimentally substantiated the principles of the ML method.
Since 1975, educational, scientific and organizational activities of V. B. Aleskovskii were associated with the Leningrad State University (LSU) since he was appointment as rector of this university.
His supervisor was Prof. V. B. Aleskovskii.
